department: School of Mechanical, Aerospace, and Materials Engineering

deadline.value: The catalog gives no application deadline for the PhD.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are required, and the PhD also needs GRE scores above set percentiles.
gre_general.quote: bachelor's and master's degree transcripts, GRE scores, and three letters of recommendation

also.quote: the student must have GRE scores that are at or above the 50th percentile for both verbal component and analytical essay component and 80th percentile for the quantitative component

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: The catalog does not say whether admitted PhD students are funded.

entry_route.value: A master's in mechanical engineering with a 3.25 GPA is required, with rare exceptions by faculty letter.
entry_route.quote: Admission to the program requires a Master of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field

notes: The university English and fee rules apply; the department repeats the same TOEFL and IELTS minimums. A faculty advisor letter can replace the GRE and TOEFL requirements in exceptional cases.
name: Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering
